title: Marta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 103a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.103a.1) we find: “Marta said in Rabbi Yehoshua’s name: ניה״ק.” He is mentioned there alongside Levi and Mar, son of Ravna. It is not known who this Marta was or who this Rabbi Yehoshua was. The better reading is that of Dikdukei Soferim there, note vav: “Marona, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.” The word Marona became corrupted into Marta when the vav and nun joined, producing a tav. He is in fact Marin, who spoke in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name in [Eruvin 19a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.19a.15).[^1]

notes.text: ניה״ק gives the order of blessings: lamp, wine, Havdalah, Kiddush. Eruvin reads Maryon, rather than Hyman’s Marin, in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Rashbam on Pesachim 103a instead gives Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah.
